name: core-comms
description: Get notified instantly when HITL items need your attention. Set up Telegram, Slack, or Email notifications for service alerts, approval requests, and critical incidents.
shortDescription: External notification channels for Telegram, Slack, and Email.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Instant Telegram notifications via your own bot
Slack webhook integration for team channels
Email alerts via SMTP - works with any provider
Configure which priorities trigger each channel

telegram.name: Telegram Bot Integration
telegram.description: Create your own Telegram bot via @BotFather and receive HITL notifications instantly. Supports private chats and groups.

slack.name: Slack Webhook Notifications
slack.description: Send alerts to any Slack channel via incoming webhooks. Rich formatting with service details and action links.

email.name: Email Notifications
email.description: SMTP-based email alerts. Works with Gmail, Outlook, SendGrid, or any email provider.

priorityFilters.name: Priority Filters
priorityFilters.description: Configure which alert priorities (critical, high, medium, low) trigger notifications on each channel.

testConnections.name: Test Connections
testConnections.description: Verify each channel is configured correctly before relying on it. One-click test sends a sample notification.

errorRecovery.name: Graceful Error Recovery
errorRecovery.description: Automatic retry with exponential backoff. Channels auto-disable after repeated failures to prevent spam.

futureFeatures: Bidirectional Telegram shipped as the separate Quox Telegram Pro plugin, not part of CoreComms
Slack interactive buttons for quick actions
